issue_context.summary: PowerToys 0.101.2362 from the Microsoft Store remains non-elevated despite the administrator-mode setting; manual elevation and the in-app restart-as-admin path also fail.
known_information: The issue is on Windows 11 25H2 with an administrator account.
Always run as administrator is enabled, but the active process remains user-mode.
Right-click Run as administrator and in-app Restart PowerToys as administrator do not change the outcome.
The attached diagnostic was rejected by automated triage because of an oversized entry.
Current code uses GeneralViewModel restart commands, runner restart scheduling, and ShellExecuteEx runas helpers.
inferences: The child may fail to elevate, may be launched from a Store-specific boundary, or may be rejected by UAC/policy.
The current loop-break behavior may hide a failed elevation by allowing a non-elevated child to continue.
issue_context.analysis: The code path is concrete enough for a yellow design, while a fresh failure-time diagnostic is needed to distinguish ShellExecuteEx failure, Store packaging, policy, or UAC denial.

To distinguish a ShellExecute/Store/UAC failure from a child-process fallback, please reproduce one failed restart and immediately submit a fresh PowerToys report with `/bugreport`; please also state whether a UAC prompt appeared and whether it was accepted. The attached archive was rejected for an oversized entry, so this fresh capture is needed to select the correct fix.

design.root_cause: The Settings restart path schedules an elevated relaunch, but the current runner path can continue or exit without proving that the child obtained an elevated token; this can present as a mode lock or silent fallback.

affected_files.purpose: Defines administrator-mode settings and restart commands.
Stores restart state and performs scheduled relaunches.
Wraps ShellExecuteExW runas and process-token helpers.
Applies startup elevation and the restarted-elevated loop-break path.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: ShellExecuteExW failure is reduced to a null handle and successful launch is not the same as an elevated child.
implementation_steps.change: Return a structured launch result or log GetLastError and retain the process handle long enough to verify token/elevation state.
implementation_steps.code_block: auto result = ShellExecuteExW(&exec_info); if (!result) return ElevationLaunchResult::Failure(GetLastError()); return VerifyChildElevation(exec_info.hProcess);
edge_cases: Close process handles on all paths.
Treat UAC cancellation distinctly from invalid path/policy failure.
tests: Unit-test failure mapping where seams exist.
Exercise accepted and denied UAC manually.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Scheduled restart records intent but does not make success observable to the exiting parent.
implementation_steps.change: Propagate the launch result to logging/UI state and only complete the restart transition after a valid child launch.
implementation_steps.code_block: if (auto result = run_elevated(...); !result.elevated) { Logger::error(...); return RestartResult::Failed; }
edge_cases: Do not introduce an elevation retry loop.
tests: Test scheduled restart with valid and invalid child paths.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: A non-elevated child with the loop-break argument can continue in user mode.
implementation_steps.change: Make failed elevation explicit for the administrator-mode flow while retaining the existing loop-break safety behavior.
edge_cases: Do not block normal non-admin startup.
tests: Simulate a non-elevated restarted child and verify a clear failure path.

verify: Build runner, common utilities, and Settings projects.
Validate Store and GitHub installs on Windows 11 25H2.
Verify Always run as administrator, in-app restart, right-click elevation, accepted UAC, denied UAC, and restart-loop protection.
risks: Store activation and UAC policy may differ from desktop ShellExecute behavior.
A token check that is too early could race child initialization.
Changing failure handling may affect unattended startup.
alternatives: Blindly retrying runas is rejected because it risks an elevation loop.
Only changing the Settings checkbox is insufficient because manual and startup relaunches also fail.
